messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a comprehensive sorting algorithms visualizer.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Implement 5 sorting algorithms: Bubble, Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix
- Visual bars with color coding: red (comparing), yellow (swapping), green (sorted), blue (pivot)
- Algorithm selection dropdown and speed control slider
- Toggle between step-by-step and continuous modes
- Real-time complexity analysis display (O-notation)
- Scramble button with patterns: Random, Reverse, Nearly Sorted
- Call stack depth visualization for recursive algorithms
- Real-time comparison and swap counters
- Working area highlighting for divide-and-conquer
- Smooth 60 FPS performance, no external libraries

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function createSortingVisualizer(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;canvas.width=500;canvas.height=500;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const UI=document.createElement('div');UI.style.fontFamily='sans-serif';UI.style.marginTop='10px';document.body.appendChild(UI);const algoSelect=document.createElement('select');['Bubble','Quick','Merge','Heap','Radix'].forEach(a=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=a;o.textContent=a;algoSelect.appendChild(o);});UI.appendChild(algoSelect);UI.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Algorithm '));const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min=1;speedSlider.max=200;speedSlider.value=50;UI.appendChild(speedSlider);UI.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Speed '));const modeToggle=document.createElement('input');modeToggle.type='checkbox';modeToggle.checked=true;UI.appendChild(modeToggle);UI.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Continuous '));UI.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));const scrambleSelect=document.createElement('select');['Random','Reverse','Nearly Sorted'].forEach(p=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p;o.textContent=p;scrambleSelect.appendChild(o);});UI.appendChild(scrambleSelect);const scrambleBtn=document.createElement('button');scrambleBtn.textContent='Scramble';UI.appendChild(scrambleBtn);UI.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));const statsDiv=document.createElement('div');statsDiv.style.marginTop='5px';UI.appendChild(statsDiv);const complexityDiv=document.createElement('div');UI.appendChild(complexityDiv);const callStackDiv=document.createElement('div');callStackDiv.style.marginTop='5px';UI.appendChild(callStackDiv);let values=[];const N=100;function initArray(){values=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)values.push(Math.floor(Math.random()*500)+5);}function scramble(pattern){if(pattern==='Random'){initArray();}else if(pattern==='Reverse'){values=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)values.push(500-i*5);}else if(pattern==='Nearly Sorted'){initArray();for(let i=0;i<N/10;i++){const a=Math.floor(Math.random()*N);const b=Math.floor(Math.random()*N);[values[a],values[b]]=[values[b],values[a]];}}resetStates();}scrambleBtn.onclick=()=>scramble(scrambleSelect.value);scramble('Random');let states=new Array(N).fill('idle');function resetStates(){states.fill('idle');}let compareCount=0,swapCount=0;function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);const barW=canvas.width/N;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){let col='gray';if(states[i]==='compare')col='red';else if(states[i]==='swap')col='yellow';else if(states[i]==='sorted')col='green';else if(states[i]==='pivot')col='blue';ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(i*barW,canvas.height-values[i],barW-1,values[i]);}statsDiv.textContent=`Comparisons: ${compareCount}   Swaps: ${swapCount}`;complexityDiv.textContent=`Complexity: ${complexityMap[algoSelect.value]||''}`;}let animationId=null;let stepDelay=0;function schedule(){if(modeToggle.checked){stepDelay=0;}else{stepDelay=1000/Number(speedSlider.value);}if(animationId)cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);let last=performance.now();function loop(now){if(now-last>=stepDelay){step();last=now;}draw();animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);}animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);}function step(){if(!generator){startSort();}const res=generator.next();if(res.done){markAllSorted();generator=null;}}function markAllSorted(){states.fill('sorted');}let generator=null;const complexityMap={Bubble:'O(n²)',Quick:'O(n log n) avg, O(n²) worst',Merge:'O(n log n)',Heap:'O(n log n)',Radix:'O(n·k)'};function startSort(){resetStates();compareCount=0;swapCount=0;callStackDiv.textContent='';const algo=algoSelect.value;if(algo==='Bubble')generator=bubbleSort();else if(algo==='Quick')generator=quickSort(0,values.length-1,0);else if(algo==='Merge')generator=mergeSort(0,values.length-1,0);else if(algo==='Heap')generator=heapSort();else if(algo==='Radix')generator=radixSort();}function compare(i,j){compareCount++;states[i]=states[j]='compare';}function swap(i,j){swapCount++;[values[i],values[j]]=[values[j],values[i]];states[i]=states[j]='swap';}function* bubbleSort(){let n=values.length;let swapped;do{swapped=false;for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){compare(i,i+1);yield;states[i]=states[i+1]='idle';if(values[i]>values[i+1]){swap(i,i+1);yield;states[i]=states[i+1]='idle';swapped=true;}}n--;states[n]='sorted';}while(swapped);for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++)states[i]='sorted';}function* quickSort(l,r,depth){if(l<r){callStackDiv.textContent=`Quick depth: ${depth}`;let p=yield* partition(l,r,depth);yield* quickSort(l,p-1,depth+1);yield* quickSort(p+1,r,depth+1);}else if(l===r){states[l]='sorted';}}function* partition(l,r,depth){states[r]='pivot';let i=l;for(let j=l;j<r;j++){compare(j,r);yield;states[j]=states[r]='idle';if(values[j]<values[r]){swap(i,j);yield;states[i]=states[j]='idle';i++;}}swap(i,r);yield;states[i]='sorted';states[r]='idle';return i;}function* mergeSort(l,r,depth){if(l<r){callStackDiv.textContent=`Merge depth: ${depth}`;let m=Math.floor((l+r)/2);yield* mergeSort(l,m,depth+1);yield* mergeSort(m+1,r,depth+1);yield* merge(l,m,r);}}function* merge(l,m,r){let left=values.slice(l,m+1);let right=values.slice(m+1,r+1);let i=0,j=0,k=l;while(i<left.length && j<right.length){compare(l+i,m+1+j);yield;states[l+i]=states[m+1+j]='idle';if(left[i]<=right[j]){values[k]=left[i];i++;}else{values[k]=right[j];j++;}k++;}while(i<left.length){values[k]=left[i];i++;k++;}while(j<right.length){values[k]=right[j];j++;k++;}for(let t=l;t<=r;t++)states[t]='sorted';}function* heapSort(){let n=values.length;for(let i=Math.floor(n/2)-1;i>=0;i--){yield* heapify(n,i);}for(let i=n-1;i>0;i--){swap(0,i);yield;states[i]='sorted';yield* heapify(i,0);}states[0]='sorted';}function* heapify(n,i){let largest=i;let l=2*i+1;let r=2*i+2;if(l<n){compare(l,largest);yield;states[l]=states[largest]='idle';if(values[l]>values[largest])largest=l;}if(r<n){compare(r,largest);yield;states[r]=states[largest]='idle';if(values[r]>values[largest])largest=r;}if(largest!==i){swap(i,largest);yield;states[i]=states[largest]='idle';yield* heapify(n,largest);} }function* radixSort(){let max=Math.max(...values);let exp=1;while(Math.floor(max/exp)>0){yield* countingSort(exp);exp*=10;}for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++)states[i]='sorted';}function* countingSort(exp){let output=new Array(values.length).fill(0);let count=new Array(10).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){let idx=Math.floor(values[i]/exp)%10;count[idx]++;}for(let i=1;i<10;i++)count[i]+=count[i-1];for(let i=values.length-1;i>=0;i--){let idx=Math.floor(values[i]/exp)%10;output[count[idx]-1]=values[i];count[idx]--; }for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){values[i]=output[i];states[i]='swap';yield;states[i]='idle';}}speedSlider.oninput=schedule;modeToggle.onchange=schedule;algoSelect.onchange=()=>{generator=null;resetStates();};schedule();}
